decisions.Kwic: 罽賓國王斬師子尊者頭，王臂自落。雪竇云：『作家君王，天然有在。』

Roles: quoted commentator on the inherited case

Decision.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Qianyan (千巖和尚語錄), public instruction. Qianyan Yuanzhang is the exact governing speaker who raises the inherited case of the king of Kashmir beheading Venerable Siṃha. Xuedou Chongxian is the explicitly named commentator quoted immediately afterward, not the speaker of the case-narration clause containing 師子. The wider case also preserves later comments by Huanglong Xin and Dahui Zonggao.
